messages:
anya: Heads up — PR touching the GPU VPC egress and a route table association is blocked by a terraform plan error in staging. Can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/5421

mike: I see the CI logs, looks like a provider version mismatch. Plan fails with:
```
Error: provider "registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws" v5.x required, but module constraint is ~> 4.
```
The module `modules/gpu/vpc` pins to ~> 4.0. CI root is using 5.x.

sam: Hit the same locally earlier. Options: run `terraform init -upgrade` in CI, or pin root to 4.x, or bump module to 5.x. Bumping to 5.x will touch a bunch of downstream modules.

rachel: Security prefers staying on 4.x because that's what's been audited for our baseline. If we must upgrade, security review will take longer. :thinking_face:

anya: OK — @mike @sam do you want me to change the module pin to a specific 4.x (e.g., 4.72.0) so CI and local runs are consistent? We need infra + security approval before merge window.

mike: I can make the module-level pin to 4.72.0 and push. Will also run `make tf-plan` locally and re-trigger CI. Adding label `infra/needs-approval`.

devops-bot: CI: terraform plan failed (exit code 2). See build 9087 details: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/builds/9087

sam: One more note — the PR also changes a route_table_association for `gpu-subnet-2`. If the plan still changes, let's avoid applying during business hours. Schedule a canary apply after 17:00 PST.

rachel: Security ok with pinning to 4.72.0 only. Will grant approval once CI shows clean plan and no risky diffs. :white_check_mark:

mike: pushed commit: pin provider to 4.72.0 in modules/gpu/vpc and updated lock file. Ran `make tf-plan` locally — plan no-op. Re-running CI now.

devops-bot: CI: terraform plan succeeded (exit code 0). Build 9090: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/builds/9090

anya: Great — can someone approve the PR? We need at least one infra + one security approval. @mike are you fine to approve? @rachel can you give security approval?

mike: approved

rachel: approved

anya: Thanks all. I'll schedule the merge for 17:00 PST then run a canary apply to staging. Leave objections here within the hour.

sam: no objections — I'll watch the canary and check gpu egress metrics after apply.

mike: on standby for rollback if anything weird shows up.

devops-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary apply to staging at 17:00 PST. Monitoring channel: #deployments-staging

anya: Closing loop — PR merged and canary applied, staging metrics look clean after 30m. Will promote to broader staging pool tomorrow morning if no regressions. Thanks everyone for quick eyes.
